summary: Backend+frontend regression completed for cover-batch safety, media integrity, optional service guards, and mobile reader visuals. TTS/Stripe disablement works, media endpoints decode correctly for all completed generated covers listed in cover batch reports, and deep-dive cover rendering is visually correct on tested stories (volcanoes-basics, octopus-brains, why-seasons). Two backend regressions found: preserved-cover baseline drifted from expected 179 (now 182), and active batch report remains 'running' while no generate_covers process is active.

critical.issue: Baseline preservation target mismatch: existing_covers snapshot is 182 (generated=135, photos=47), not expected 179 (132+47).
Batch report still says status=running but no active 'python generate_covers.py' process found; lock dry-run protection could not be runtime-verified because process appears inactive/stale.

action_items: Investigate why preserved baseline in running batch snapshot is 182 instead of required 179 (132 generated + 47 photo), and confirm whether pre-run state changed before snapshot creation.
Add/verify batch heartbeat/finalizer so run status cannot remain 'running' when process has exited; then re-run dry-run lock test while process is truly active.
After batch-state fix, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iter29_cover_batch_regression.py to confirm baseline + lock assertions.
No frontend fix required for the reported blank-cover bug based on current reproduction: images are visible and correctly layered on tested stories.
critical_code_review_comments: generate_covers.py has proper compare-and-set protection ('hero_image_generated' empty + 'hero_image' unchanged) and atomic report checkpoint writes via temp file replace.
optional_services.py guard correctly enforces clean 503 on /api/tts/* regardless of image key presence; verified across voices/status/story/warmup endpoints.
story-hero.tsx uses useId() inside testID, producing non-stable runtime IDs; this is not a product bug, but it reduces deterministic UI test selector stability.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (critical visual + mobile flows passed; no runtime errors observed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Current snapshot counts from d92 report: generated length=65, existing generated=135, existing photo-only=47. /tmp/pause_cover_batch.log ends mid-run, but process not found via pgrep. Deep-dive cover issue was rechecked with DOM metrics: chapter-cover-bg and deep-dive-cover-card geometries match; hero images have naturalWidth=896 and are visibly rendered in screenshots.
rca_of_issue: Blank cover bug not reproducible in this run. DOM shows loaded hero (naturalWidth>0) with visible rect fully inside chapter-cover-bg and screenshots confirm rendered image. Most likely prior capture timing/race (screenshot before image paint) or earlier transient overlay/paint artifact, not current deterministic stacking failure. Separate backend RCA: batch report state appears stale because process is absent while status remains running, indicating missing/failed final status checkpoint path on interrupted execution.
